applies_when: Long instructions include specialized branches rarely needed
instruction: Move optional detailed guidance to references and retain explicit conditional links from SKILL.md; preserve every requirement.

applies_when: The same deterministic operation is repeatedly reconstructed
instruction: Move deterministic repeated operations into a small executable script; preserve input checks and error handling. This reference repository is deprecated; use only the pinned pattern, not its installation instructions.

applies_when: Identical requirements appear in multiple entry points
instruction: Consolidate duplicate instructions into one referenced document without removing checks, permissions, or required outputs.

applies_when: Repeated tool setup or deterministic validation dominates execution
instruction: Reuse one existing command or script for repeated setup and validation; preserve the native execution harness and all mandatory verification.
